value.signature: fn finish_check_command < T : serde :: Serialize > (command_name : & str , output : & CheckOutputArgs , report : & T ,) -> Result < () , CheckResultError >

exception.justification: Justified: This publication adapter inherits the checker command context and delegates all serialized output and file work to their separately observed boundaries without serializing a report twice.

review.body: { match (& output . report , & output . stamp) { (None , None) => { if let Some (record) = stdout_tty_refusal_record (command_name) { let _ignored = emit_control_plane_record (& record) ; return Err (CheckResultError :: TtyRefusal) ; } emit (report) ? ; Ok (()) } (Some (report_path) , Some (stamp_path)) => { ensure_distinct_outputs (& [("report" , report_path) , ("stamp" , stamp_path)]) ? ; let _change = write_json_report_if_changed (report_path , report) ? ; touch_stamp (stamp_path) ? ; Ok (()) } _ => Err (CheckResultError :: InvalidMode) , } }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-cli decision for finish_check_command.
